name: bleach-idle-online
description: Bleach Idle Online: fangame idle MMO de navegador (sem vínculo oficial com Bleach).

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @bio/shared && concurrently -n server,client -c red,cyan "npm run dev -w @bio/server" "npm run dev -w @bio/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @bio/shared && npm run build -w @bio/server && npm run build -w @bio/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @bio/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
